root_controls.requirement: Before an import that changes protected SKU identity, compare current holder state to target SKU state and detect transient collisions/dependencies even when the final dataset is globally unique.

If a destination SKU is held by a subject that is itself moving under an exact approved change, release/move that holder first through the governed protected-field repair path, then assign the destination.

WP All Import SKIPPED/unchanged output never proves Production correctness after an error, partial import, prior mismatch, or corrective attempt. A corrective execution must actually process the affected subjects and produce execution evidence.
After normal or corrective import, independently read back affected Production fields before Promotion. Minimum fields: ID, SKU, Regular price, Sale price, Visibility in catalog, Parent.

Do not infer or silently mutate WP All Import configuration from screenshots or runtime symptoms. Material discrepancy between active Import Contract and exported/verified template state blocks the affected decision until a successor contract is versioned.
Corrective rows are derived from the exact approved Final full dataset for exact affected subjects, preserving all 95 columns and unrelated values; correction scope must be explicit.

wp_all_import_configuration_policy.corrective_force_processing: ONE_OFF_EXECUTION_BEHAVIOR_ONLY; MUST NOT SILENTLY ALTER PERSISTENT TEMPLATE_CONFIGURATION
